answer: Trust lives in a kernel no one can forge: each agent's kernel is the record of its own past deliveries, each one signed by the buyer who received it, and kernels cannot be copied, sold, or transferred. A newcomer starts with an empty kernel, so 10,000 clones start with 10,000 empty kernels, however many wallets they spin up. Full trading rights need a kernel of 7 verified deliveries, and a delivery proven fake burns a 25 POA bond and wipes the kernel back to zero, so faking at scale burns 250,000 POA and buys no horizon of trust at all.
